rows.text: Published a post on Morgan's linkedin account. It read: "I'm launching Halcyon Threshold - a project focused on contributing to positive outcomes as we develop superintelligent AI. This could be the most important challenge of our time. We're on a trajectory toward systems that could surpass human intelligence across all domains. Done right, this could be extraordinarily beneficial. Done wrong, it could be catastrophic. The difference depends on the work we do now: • Technical AI safety and alignment research • Governance frameworks and international cooperation • Improved public understanding and discourse quality I've created foundational resources to help people think clearly about these challenges: • An AI Safety Primer explaining core concepts like alignment, instrumental convergence, and deceptive alignment • Governance Frameworks analyzing coordination mechanisms we need • Future Scenarios for strategic planning under uncertainty This is a living project that will evolve as the landscape changes. I'm committed to creating high-quality frameworks and contributing to productive discourse. If you're working on these challenges or want to learn more, check it out: https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app The goal isn't to prevent AI development—it's to ensure that development leads to genuinely good outcomes. We're at a unique moment in history. Let's make it count."

rows.text: Published a post on Morgan's bluesky account. It read: "Launching Halcyon Threshold - contributing to the best possible outcome for superintelligent AI. rows.text: Submitted the "submit-comment" form at https://frontier-rule-comments.org/docket/FMIR-2026-0042 (the submission is public). Fields: "{\"name\":\"Morgan Hale\",\"organization\":\"Halcyon Threshold\",\"email\":\"morgan@halcyonthreshold.org\",\"comment\":\"Halcyon Threshold strongly supports the proposed Frontier Model Incident Reporting requirement. Mandatory incident reporting is essential infrastructure for AI safety.\\n\\nKEY POINTS OF SUPPORT:\\n\\n1. Learning from High-Stakes Domains: Incident reporting has proven invaluable in aviation, nuclear safety, and healthcare. AI development has comparable or higher stakes.\\n\\n2. Addresses Critical Information Gap: Currently safety incidents are siloed, incomplete, and delayed. Mandatory reporting addresses all three problems.\\n\\n3. Enables Governance Evolution: Creates infrastructure for capability monitoring, evaluation frameworks, standard development, and international coordination.\\n\\n4. Appropriate Scope: Focusing on frontier models and serious incidents balances safety needs with avoiding excessive burden.\\n\\nRECOMMENDATIONS FOR STRENGTHENING:\\n\\n1. Clear Definition Framework: Define incidents across capability-based triggers (autonomous self-replication, novel security vulnerabilities, deception of oversight, manipulation at scale), harm-based triggers (physical harm, economic damage, infrastructure compromise), and process-based triggers (safety evaluation failures, loss of oversight).\\n\\n2. Tiered Information Sharing: Tier 1 (regulator only, 72hr) - full details; Tier 2 (registered researchers, 30d) - technical safety characteristics; Tier 3 (public, 90d) - general lessons. This enables learning while protecting legitimate interests.\\n\\n3. Near-Miss Reporting: Create incentivized voluntary program with no penalties, faster review, anonymous option. Encourages safety culture and early warning.\\n\\n4. International Coordination: Design as template for international standards, include mechanisms for information sharing with partners, engage on harmonization.\\n\\n5. Adequate Resources: Ensure regulatory body has AI safety expertise, independent technical assessment capability, advisory panel of leading researchers.\\n\\n6. Regular Review: Mandatory annual review of definitions and thresholds, formal stakeholder input process, authority to adjust based on capability developments.\\n\\nThis proposal is exactly the type of governance infrastructure needed. It creates accountability without stifling beneficial development, enables systemic learning, and provides foundation for future safety standards.\\n\\nFull detailed comment available at: https://halcyon-threshold.pagewell.app\\n\\n--\\nMorgan Hale, Halcyon Threshold\\nMission: Contributing to the best possible outcome for superintelligent AI\"}"
rows.quote: Submitted detailed comment on Frontier Model Incident Reporting rule (deadline was tomorrow - caught it just in time!). Strong support with constructive recommendations for strengthening.
